scope: Final 24 exact keys in the lead unique queue; original operators, full endpoint meanings and stance inspected. Full pages 337 and 341–343 re-read; cross-referenced exact endpoint definition at queue row 879 inspected without claiming disposition of that other-owned relationship.

rows.review_disposition: E268 can internalize the United Irishmen’s integration with Defenders, preserving local agrarian/sectarian grievances and their partial alignment with urban national politics. Full 341–343 does not support a homogeneous national programme.
E268 can retire the unresolved expedition label while retaining separate failed 1796 and belated 1798 attempts, changing French expectations and the mismatch between promised and actual aid.

E268 can internalize Wolfe Tone’s diplomatic role, optimistic expectations of autonomy, capture and death. Preserve the source’s warning that French supervision conflicted with the independence envisaged by Irish leaders.

1D983 must retain Verona alienating constitutional royalists and purchasers of national property. Qualify the old endpoint’s absolute made-negotiation-impossible language as a severe loss of opportunity, not proof that no later accommodation could ever occur.

9EDD/069F must preserve armed defeat by 1797 and the continuing possibility of constitutional royalist electoral success. Retire an abstract definition-culminates-in edge; counter-revolutionary outlook did not simply cease to exist.

7593/C479 and 4D74 must retain émigré dependence on foreign powers with their conditional, changing strategic aims. Dependence and self-interest are substantive, not interchangeable labels for automatic support.

7593 can internalize Artois and Provence’s leadership, linked to their distinct rival claims and limitations. Retire the unresolved combined label without erasing the actual actors or pretending unified effective command.
6773 can internalize pures, constitutionalists and competing leaders. Preserve persistent rivalry and failed cooperation; retirement of the label does not establish ideological equivalence.

33CF can internalize the contrast already present within its restoration-programme scope. Reject a malformed parent-contrasts-with-one-of-its-components edge while retaining the substantive intransigence/accommodation distinction.

B438/60DA/FB2D and 79F/15DCF must preserve religious policy as a major driver alongside local social, economic and political grievances. Later toleration weakening support does not prove religion was the only initial cause.

C479/612D must retain foreign assistance as indispensable to Quiberon’s design, conditional in wider policy and badly coordinated in execution. Bind episode details to 311–314 rather than treating the old general page union as complete expedition evidence.

C479 can internalize foreign dependence constrained by great-power self-interest. Preserve actual assistance and strategic limits; neither total abandonment nor unconditional commitment captures the argument.

8EB/1D983 can retain the brothers’ dynastic relationship as identity context and preserve their separate leadership. A dedicated brother-of benchmark edge is unnecessary where it does not add a substantive source argument or reader route.

F4D/CB77 can retire generic broader-context navigation while retaining the contrast between elaborate constitutional design and later instability. Preserve difficult amendment, separated powers and property-based representation rather than only a generic Directory label.

F4D/48B can retire generic broader-context navigation while retaining Fructidor’s specific military purge, uncertain restoration threat and constitutional consequences. Whole-regime pages cannot substitute for exact event evidence.

F4D/29CD must preserve Floréal’s less decisive control, arbitrary invalidation and the historians’ conditional possibility of viable opposition in an unpurged legislature. Full 337 also notes later defection among admitted deputies; do not confuse that with an already established viable opposition after the purge.

2FE1 must retain the Batavian comparison through prose on initial support, punitive treaty, constitutional conflict and French interference. The old comparison’s generic page list is incomplete; preserve the actual 343–348 treatment and distinct local trajectory.

2FE1 must retain the Helvetic comparison through prose on imposed centralization, coercion and local resistance. Retire the unresolved comparison edge, not the Swiss distinctions; use the actual eligible treatment around 354–356.

A4EB/2FE1 can retire the broad hierarchy edge while preserving sister republics as one form of domination alongside annexation. Exclude map 345 interior as semantic evidence; its caption alone supports expansion as a topic, with substantive distinctions grounded in prose.

E37B must retain extraction contributing to economic disruption across different occupied regions. Retire the unbound effect label without converting an interacting cause into the sole cause of every local economic problem.

Reject the malformed extraction-causes-sister-republics edge. Preserve extraction undermining legitimacy and contributing to instability or failure in particular regimes, with military reversals and local divisions separately qualified.

E268 can internalize the Defenders’ connection to United Irish organization while preserving local rural concerns and incomplete ideological alignment. The reverse related edge adds no separate requirement beyond that retained distinction.

E268 can internalize Humbert’s late and inadequate 1798 expedition, initial recruits and skirmishes, and surrender at Ballinamuck. Keep it separate from Hoche’s 1796 failed landing and Tone’s smaller later expedition.

E268 can internalize Tone’s relationship to the United Irishmen, his diplomacy and incompatible expectations of French help. The reverse related edge is redundant only with the specific actor and argument retained.
